fusions.name: Folded Darts
fusions.desc: Looses 5 folded darts at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Fine Edge
fusions.desc: A slicing swipe that deals 12 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slipped Fold
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away.

fusions.name: Rewritten Odds
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
